title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Telephone-Fee Route Rate
content:
**Rule.** The telephone-fee route rate on a call-center redemption of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers follows the itinerary class of the ticket the redemption paid for, as that ticket is recorded under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand:

(a) 0.60 when the ticket is a long-haul international itinerary;
(b) 0.80 when it is a short-haul international itinerary;
(c) 1 when it is domestic.

| Itinerary class of the ticket the redemption paid for | Route rate |
|---|---|
| long-haul international | 0.60 |
| short-haul international | 0.80 |
| domestic | 1 |

**Which ticket.** The ticket read is the one paid for by the call-center redemption that the telephone fee belongs to.

**Hypothetical application.** A call-center redemption that paid for a short-haul international ticket carries a route rate of 0.80, and one that paid for a domestic ticket carries 1.
